description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions, constants, and a nested MemorySnapshot class, serving as an interface for system-related data access.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata. Implements singleton pattern and includes nested MemorySnapshot class for capturing memory state.

classes.name: MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of system memory statistics, with methods to output data as JSON and access individual metrics.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the update.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Outputs the memory snapshot as a JSON string.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory statistics.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns current system ticks in microseconds.
